# TN step 3 tables (generated by tools/tn/summarise.py; copies in tails results/tn/step3/summary_*)

Mean ± std over 3 seeds; z = (mean - chance) / binomial SE; OOV = fraction of test sentences with an unseen word (per config).
Plateau runs report best.pt (val mrr_mean). Configs: base = step-2 model (glorot init), basen = step-2 model + norm init, dt2/dt3 = decoupled, MPS on type tensors of order >= 2 / >= 3.
